mcqs.q: Which statement is most appropriate for Photoelectric effect?
options: The governing relation must be applied with consistent SI units.
Units can be ignored because equations are unit-independent.
A scalar can always replace a vector without changing the result.
Dimensional consistency guarantees every equation is physically correct.
